matchup.holding: Aday Mara (OKC, 3 games next week), Payton Pritchard (BOS, 3 games next week).
matchup.plan_title: Plan (10:00 UTC 18 Nov): claim Jeremiah Fears, drop Jenkins
matchup.plan_md:
**Fears is on waivers** after another team dropped him.
- **He clears Thu 19 Nov at 3:00 AM ET, 7:00 PM Thu 19 Melbourne** (ESPN's `waiverProcessDate`).
- **Our priority:** the league uses traditional waivers, and we are 6th of 8. Ahead of us are Cream Abdul-Yammar, Matt Wright's Foxies, Snow Time Lakers, Lauri Birds and Dr White Slong. If any of them claims him, they get him.
- **The drop goes through when the claim processes,** before any 19 Nov game.
- **His games for us this week:** 20 Nov (@OKC) and 21 Nov (@SA).

**Which player to drop.** Each row is the lineup total from 19 to 22 Nov, from `--swap ... --from 2026-11-19`. Each swap is one of the 5 adds left.

| Option | Adds for the plan | Lineup 19–22 Nov |
|---|---:|---:|
| No claim | 5 | 1,035 (917 + 117.7) |
| **Claim Fears, drop Jenkins** | 4 | **1,005** (912 + 93.4) |
| Claim Fears, drop Bamba | 4 | 994 (922 + 71.5) |
| Claim Fears, drop Gobert | 4 | 993 (934 + 59.4) |

**Why Jenkins:**
- The claim costs about 30 this week against no claim. With no more moves we still lead the projection 1,885 to 1,589.
- Jenkins plays tonight (18 Nov) before the claim processes.
- His start ends when Duren returns: re-evaluation about 22 Nov ([Detroit Sports Nation, 8 Nov](https://detroitsportsnation.com/jb-bickerstaff-jalen-duren-hamstring-update/gkaplan/detroit-pistons/11/08/2026/505901/)); *ESPN est.* 24 Nov.
- Fears is starting-level now. He has played 28–34 min in his last five, with a first career triple-double on 16 Nov (19/10/10 in 29 min, [SI, 17 Nov](https://www.si.com/nba/pelicans/onsi/3-takeaways-from-pelicans-win-over-warriors-as-jeremiah-fears-records-first-triple-double)).
- Dejounte Murray is away from the team until he is traded ([Yahoo, 13 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/dejounte-murray-sit-until-trade-203559326.html)).

**After the claim: 4 adds, +93.4** (ESPN dates, Melbourne times):
1. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert after his game vs NY ends (tip-off Fri 20, 12:00 PM). Add **Quentin Grimes** (LAL) before his game vs SAC (Sat 21, 2:00 PM).
   - Only if Austin Reaves is still out. Grimes starts "as long as Reaves is out" ([NBC Sports, 17 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-17/redick-reaves-to-test-injured-heel-wednesday)). Reaves tests his heel on 18 Nov; *ESPN est.* 18 Nov.
2. **21 Nov:** drop Grimes after his game. Add **Derik Queen** (NO) before NO @SA (Sun 22, 12:00 PM).
3. **21 Nov:** drop Bamba after his game on 20 Nov (tip-off Sat 21, 1:30 PM). Add **Payton Pritchard** (BOS) before BOS @SAC (Sun 22, 2:00 PM).
4. **22 Nov:** drop Queen after his game at SA. Add **Aday Mara** (OKC) before OKC @MIA (Mon 23, 10:00 AM).

**If Reaves is back** (`--sit` Grimes, and Edey on 19 Nov): **3 adds, +85.1.**
- **20 Nov:** Gobert → Queen.
- **21 Nov:** Bamba → Pritchard.
- **22 Nov:** Queen → Mara.

**If the claim fails** (a team ahead of us takes him), follow the no-claim plan, **5 adds, +117.7**:
- **19 Nov:** Bamba → Zach Edey, only if Memphis clears him for the back-to-back.
- **20 Nov:** Gobert → Queen, and Edey → Grimes (only if Reaves is out).
- **21 Nov:** Grimes → Pritchard.
- **22 Nov:** Queen → Mara.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Jeremiah Fears | 34.4 | 32.5 (15) | 37.2 (4) | 35.1 (9) | 32.5 (15) |
| Daniss Jenkins | 33.0 (role rate 35.8 ‡) | 30.2 (13) | 37.0 (3) | 34.6 (7) | 30.2 (13) |
| Payton Pritchard | 27.7 | 26.8 (14) | 28.8 (4) | 25.8 (8) | 26.8 (14) |
| Quentin Grimes | 36.9 | 23.2 (13) | 59.0 (2), small sample | 29.3 (6) | 23.2 (13) |

Jenkins's L7 is +6.8, from starting while Duren is out. Grimes's L7 is +35.8, from two starts with Reaves out, a small sample.
